notes.title: 🎉 Releasing on 7th of October! 🎉
notes.content:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="R6Z-zTJcIro;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The game is now finished and ready to be played! Explore the school and uncover over +50 anomalies whilst finding your way to floor 0...
[/p][h3]
[b]Since start of development and initial publication of the Steam page we have updated a few things. We now have:[/b][/h3][p][b]🎭 55 Anomalies to find[/b][/p][p][b]📜 4 Endings to experience[/b][/p][p]📖 [b]Anomaly Book to track your progress[/b][/p][p][b]🎯 11 Steam achievements to unlock[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][/h3][h3][b]What can you expect from Last Term?[/b][/h3][p]From our conducted playtests [b][u]the average playtime to reaching floor 0 is 56 minutes[/u][/b]. However of course it can vary on what anomalies you encounter and how well you can spot the differences...[/p][p]The anomalies range from settle (to test your memory) and interactive or scary ones to make it more fun.[/p][p]Additionally to getting the main ending, there is 3 more to see as well as all of the achievements to unlock! This can provide over a couple of hours of gameplay for those who wish to do it all.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Big thank you to everyone who wishlisted and has been waiting to play the game![/b][/p][p]This is our first commercial title and it has been quite the experience for the both of us. We're only getting started and we have a lot more planned, with more games in development and on the way...[/p][p][b]Jakub & Adam 🗿[/b][/p]
